questions.prompt: What is the strongest rendering review note for a Next.js 16 App Router page?

options.label: Classify the whole page as either SSR or static and stop there.
Classify each subtree by cached, request-time, and client-owned behavior.
Move uncertain data work to Client Components to avoid server rendering decisions.

questions.explanation: Next.js 16 rendering is compositional. The safe review identifies cache, runtime, Suspense, and client boundaries per subtree.

questions.prompt: Which route is the best candidate for a static shell plus streamed dynamic section?

options.label: A product page with stable content and a personalized inventory panel.
An admin route where every section depends on per-user permissions.
A fully client-side canvas game with no server data.

questions.explanation: Partial prerendering shines when stable shell content can be shown while a smaller request-time section resolves.
